dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline trajectory along the trailing edge boundary from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological vertex with a medium pixel radius, classified as an obtuse-rounded apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear contour at approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular, hypopigmented lesions (punctate marks) distributed across the lateral surface of the fin, likely resulting from healed parasitic attachments or shark interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white, rectangular tag-like appendage is visible attached to the dorsal-most point of the apex.
